controls.narrative: I picked up the lantern and carried it with me.
A lantern hung on a hook by the door, unlit.
I never found the ledger, though I searched.
I examined the trowel closely, turning it over.
The trowel lay where someone had dropped it.
I walked north into the vault and looked around.
The vault lay somewhere to the north, unvisited.
I spent the whole time in the nursery and went nowhere else.
